in_game_description: Whether or not you want to cook a tasty dish, or study them for research purposes, Vossk organs aren't readily available and you will usually have to search long and hard for them.
mechanics_text: Were the most valuable commodity in the entire game until Supernova introduced Chromo Plasma and K'mirkk Toad Mutagen.
Comparable to Buskat in rarity; sell at ~27,000$ per ton (~32,000$ with Supernova).
Sao Perula in the Loma system always stocks Vossk Organs.
Can be found in Pan alongside regular Organs; sell at Loma or Thynome for best profits.
